# Interface Logger

Logger interface for ADK.

interface Logger {  
debug(...args: unknown[]): void;  
error(...args: unknown[]): void;  
info(...args: unknown[]): void;  
log(level: [LogLevel](../enums/LogLevel.html), ...args: unknown[]): void;  
setLogLevel(level: [LogLevel](../enums/LogLevel.html)): void;  
warn(...args: unknown[]): void;  
}
